# BricoHams · LibreSat LSR-2: materials and cost budget, both routes (generated by calc/lsr2_materials.py)

<!-- palette: blue #12263f, orange #e8871e -->
Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina.

Goal: light and cheap. Geometry from `build/lsr2_build_report.json` (phase-11 build); every price, rate and yield is PARAMETRIC and **VERIFY** with local quotes. Route A = printed pattern, sand-cast A356-T6, machining of the stock pads; route B = 3-axis CNC from 6082/6061 block.

Parameters: A356 ingot 4.5 EUR/kg, foundry 8.0 EUR/kg of casting, yield 0.55, shrink 1.013, PLA 20 EUR/kg at 1.24 g/cm³ with 25 % fill, series 1 (pattern shared by that many rotators), CNC block 11.0 EUR/kg, removal rate 15.0 cm³/min, set-up 25.0 min, machine 40.0 EUR/h, cast machining 2 set-ups.

Route B cost counts the number of set-ups of docs/LSR2_ROUTE_B_CNC.md; the body is machined as bolted slabs (joint sealing is an open decision) and some of its horizontal features need a 4th axis or an angle plate (also open), so its route-B number is optimistic. Default route per part = cheaper; within 5 % the lighter.

## Turned shafts (stainless 1.4404)

Stock = finished length + 10 mm, diameter = largest step + 3 mm; 7.95 g/cm³; 6.0 EUR/kg (VERIFY).

| Shaft | Stock Ø x L (mm) | Stock (g) | Finished (g) | Cost (EUR) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| az_shaft | 33 x 250 | 1700 | 760 | 10.2 |
| el_shaft | 23 x 251 | 829 | 437 | 5.0 |
| el_sleeve | 23 x 67 | 221 | 73 | 1.3 |

Cross boom 6063 40x40x3 x 1600 mm = 1.92 kg (in the bought-part total).
